notes: Self-hosted HindsightServer in-process, embedded PostgreSQL (pg0) on loopback, run as an unprivileged user with an allowlisted environment (no tokens; CA bundle unreadable, so no outbound TLS).
Embedding call count is a placeholder of 1: per-chunk embedding calls were not instrumented.
CPU shared with other benchmark processes; latencies are not comparable performance measurements.
Executed via reference/run_longmemeval_resumable.py (per-question resumable driver), finalized with --finalize; run identity in hindsight-500.exec.json.
limitations: Measures Hindsight as a credential-free chunk retrieval memory, not its LLM fact-extraction / observation product mode.
Retain passes no timestamp; temporal retrieval is disabled in this profile.
Candidate: requires independent adapter/protocol review before acceptance.
